episode.episode_title: Anthropic's IPO: A Billion-Dollar Balancing Act
episode.episode_description: We break down the eye-watering figures in Anthropic's draft IPO prospectus, where revenue growth meets massive compute obligations and complex accounting.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

selected_story.headline: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals Massive Scale and Risk
selected_story.source_title: IPO prospectus: Anthropic reports a net loss of $42B in 2025, with operating losses of $8B+; revenue grew 12x to ~$4.6B, ~25% of which came from two customers (Echo Wang/Reuters)

short.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals Massive Scale and Risk
short.description:
The figures highlight the extreme capital intensity of frontier AI development, where massive revenue growth is currently dwarfed by the costs of compute and valuation-related accounting liabilities.

short.script: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals Massive Scale and Risk. Anthropic’s draft S-1 shows 2025 revenue of $4.6B against an $8.06B operating loss and a $42B net loss, largely driven by non-cash valuation adjustments. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
